Life expectancy data in 1998

Source: R/data-lifeexp.R
lifeexp.Rd

Country indicators for 1998 from the World Bank's World Development Indicators, arranged like Stata's lifeexp.dta example. This dataset contains variable labels, value labels and missing values.

Usage

lifeexp

Format

A tibble with 68 rows and 6 variables:

region

Region (with value labels)

country

Country

popgrowth

Annual population growth rate (%)

lexp

Life expectancy at birth (years)

gnppc

GNI per capita, Atlas method (current US$)

safewater

People using safely managed drinking water services (% of population) in 2000

Source

World Bank, World Development Indicators, https://datatopics.worldbank.org/world-development-indicators/, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Indicators SP.POP.GROW, SP.DYN.LE00.IN and NY.GNP.PCAP.CD for 1998 and SH.H2O.SMDW.ZS for 2000; values are rounded. Country names follow WDI, and Serbia stands in for the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia. See the installed DATA-PROVENANCE.md for the retrieval date and build script.

Examples

lifeexp
#> # A tibble: 68 × 6
#>    region               country                popgrowth  lexp gnppc safewater
